definitions.gloss: wild mountain vegetables, edible wild plants
definitions.explanation: Edible plants that grow wild in the mountains and fields. Gathering and eating them is a traditional seasonal activity in Japan, especially in spring.

examples.english: To gather wild vegetables in spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧にした{山菜|さんさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Wild mountain vegetables made into tempura are very delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧{山菜|さんさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採|と}り→採る：20862_toru⟧、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Every spring, my grandmother goes into the mountains to gather wild vegetables and shares them with the neighbors.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{山|さん} (mountain) + {菜|さい} (vegetable, greens).

USAGE:
{山菜|さんさい} refers to a broad category of wild edible plants harvested from mountains and forests. Gathering them ({山菜|さんさい}{採|と}り) is a popular seasonal activity in spring. Common varieties include ⟦{蕨|わらび}→蕨：30491_warabi⟧ (bracken fern), ⟦{蕗|ふき}→蕗：30515_fuki⟧ (butterbur), and たらの{芽|め} (aralia sprouts). Many require preparation such as removing bitterness (⟦{灰汁|あく}{抜|ぬ}き→灰汁抜き：06818_akunuki⟧) before eating.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山菜|さんさい}{採|と}り: gathering wild vegetables
- {山菜|さんさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: tempura of wild vegetables
- {山菜|さんさい}そば: soba noodles with wild vegetables
- {山菜|さんさい}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: wild vegetable cuisine
